limitations: Producer p95 is the final rolling 1024 new-write window, not an interval percentile.
Saga p95 and per-pod endpoint p95 may contain earlier samples; endpoint p95s cannot be added.
Rates use producer baseline-receipt to final-request-start monotonic duration; reader counters are sampled slightly later.
Missing evidence remains null. Sampled backpressure absence does not establish continuous absence.
Confirmed/cancelled deltas include completions of earlier pending writes; they need not equal accepted writes. Nonzero recovered deltas require manual replay review.
Reader outcomes come from interval logs, not starts/request counters. Fully contained reports omit boundary intervals.
SQL totals require all three shards. Drain evidence is associated by monotonic directory timestamp.
